subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Hyundai Ioniq 5
description: A quick win: understand The Hyundai Ioniq 5.

hook.text: Hyundai used to mean cheap and boring. The Ioniq 5 changed that perception overnight.

buildup.text: Its retro-futuristic design was inspired by the 1975 Hyundai Pony—sharp lines and pixel-style lights.

discovery.text: It charged from 10% to 80% in just 18 minutes on 800-volt architecture—faster than most rivals.

twist.text: It won World Car of the Year in 2022, beating BMW, Mercedes, and every established premium brand.

climax.text: Korean automakers went from budget copycats to genuine design and technology leaders in one generation.

punchline.text: Hyundai stopped chasing rivals and started leading them.
